name: Sasmita Rout

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sasmita Rout writes in Odia. Her Kabita Live poem “ଈଶ୍ବର” gives longing a restless, searching voice: dark clouds withhold their rain, dawn is examined for a lost presence, and nights seem to demand physical endurance. Memories, dreams and offers of love fail to bring an answer.

The final image reverses the poem’s apparent direction. An accidental footfall upon the speaker’s chest provokes a startled response, as though the neglected speaker were divine. That turn keeps the poem poised between devotion, desire and the pain of being overlooked.
